# Brush Floss

> A multi-location pediatric and family dental practice across Metro West Massachusetts offering comprehensive care from infant dentistry through orthodontics.

Brush Floss operates six locations (Hopkinton, Westborough, Weston, Wayland, Millis, and Grafton) specializing in pediatric dentistry, family care, and orthodontics with advanced 3D imaging technology. The practice emphasizes preventive care, patient education through community outreach, and flexible treatment options including in-house clear aligners.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Clear Aligners
- Family Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Multi-Location Practice
- 3D Imaging (i-CAT, iTero)
- Children's Dental Care
- Dental Services
- Patient Reviews
- Pear Align
- Annual Membership Plan
- Metro West Massachusetts
- New Patient Forms
- Community Outreach

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.brushfloss.com/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services with i-CAT 3D imaging and preventive care
- [Adult Dentistry](https://www.brushfloss.com/adult-dentistry): Adult dental services including preventive, restorative, and cosmetic care
- [Orthodontics](https://www.brushfloss.com/orthodontics): Orthodontic treatments with clear aligners, braces, and iTero 3D imaging
- [In-House Aligners](https://www.brushfloss.com/aligners): Pear Align in-house clear aligner treatment options and pricing
- [Infant Space](https://www.brushfloss.com/infant-space): Infant dental care guide covering tongue-tie, cleft palate, and baby teeth

## Locations

- [All Locations](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations): BrushFloss office locations across Metro West Massachusetts
- [Dental Place Hopkinton](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations/hopkinton): Dental Place Hopkinton location with pediatric and orthodontic services
- [Dental Place Westborough](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations/westborough): Dental Place Westborough pediatric and family dentistry location
- [Weston Pediatric Dental](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations/weston): Weston Pediatric Dental location offering pediatric and orthodontic care
- [Pediatric Dental of Wayland](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations/wayland): Pediatric Dental of Wayland location for children's dental care
- [Pediatric Dental of Millis](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations/millis): Pediatric Dental of Millis location with family dentistry services
- [Pediatric Dental of Grafton](https://www.brushfloss.com/locations/grafton): Pediatric Dental of Grafton location in North Grafton, Massachusetts
